mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_usage(user_id, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, duration_ms, session_id, question, tenant_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{model}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{durationMs}, #{sessionId}, #{question}, #{tenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT ts, user_id AS "user", model, prompt_tokens AS "promptTokens", completion_tokens AS "completionTokens", duration_ms AS "durationMs", session_id AS "sessionId", question FROM model_usage WHERE ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT model, COUNT(*) AS reqs, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens),0) AS pt, COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens),0) AS ct FROM model_usage WHERE GROUP BY model ORDER BY reqs DESC
